entries.name: Text
entries.description: A paragraph of text. With `markdown: true`, two stars on each side make bold and backticks make code; nothing else is markup, so text from an API shows as written. Good for a note, a status line, or the one thing a tile has to say.

root.text: **Release freeze** starts Thursday at 18:00. Ask in `#deploys` before merging, and tag the release with `v2.4.0`.
